title: Episode
description: A cartoon episode. Every id that refers to a character rig, action, background or camera must exist in the library; validate.mjs checks those references.

kararlar.description: Choices the person made before the script approval (cizgi onayla senaryo refuses until all are set and the episode agrees with them): boyut 2b|3b (3b also needs stil3d), muzik var|yok (var: music is set), efekt var|yok (yok: no shot has sfx), altyazi var|yok (yok: altyazi.kapali).

eksik_cizim.description: When a drawing is missing (new_assets): ask the person before each (sor), or use a stand-in and go on (yer_tutucu). Asked only when something is missing.

stil3d.description: The look of a 3D render (the 2D render ignores it): toon (flat bands of light and an outline, the default), yumusak (smooth shading and soft shadows), pastel (soft colours, a thin outline, a light shadow), golge (toon bands with a shadow, no outline).

altyazi.description: Captions of the whole episode: kapali turns them all off; konusan_rengi edges each caption with its speaker's colour (characters[].renk).

renk.description: The character's colour in the timeline and on its captions (default: by its place in the cast).

dekor.description: Library props standing in the scene for all its shots, behind the characters (a tree, a bench). x in world units; back, olcek and ters as for cast.

akis.description: The piece moves all through its scene (a crowd walking by): dx world units a second sideways, back a second into depth (+ away, - toward the camera). It comes round again at the edge.

katmanlar.description: Per-scene settings of the background's layers, by layer id (a one-file background has one layer: tum).

altyazi.description: Where (alt, ust, orta) and how big (kucuk, orta, buyuk) the scene's captions are. Default: alt in 16:9, ust in 9:16; orta.

gecis.description: How the scene begins: kararma dips to black and back over about 0.6 s around the cut, kesme is a hard cut. Default: kesme when the scene goes on in the same place and time of day as the one before, else kararma.

isik.description: Light and time of day of the scene: a colour grade over its world (not the captions). ogle is the drawing as it is; guc is how strongly (default 1).

seri.description: The series this episode belongs to: seriler/<id>.json in the project folder. dogrula checks the episode against it (characters, voices, format, order) and against the episode before.

kabul_uyarilar.description: dogrula warnings the person decided to keep, by code, with their reason. Written only after the person's yes (cizgi uyari-kabul). Any other open warning holds the approvals.

cevap.description: The person's answer for this missing drawing (when kararlar.eksik_cizim is sor).

music.description: Background music from library/muzik under the whole film, faded in and out and turned down while lines are spoken.

duck.description: Share of the volume kept while a line is spoken; default 0.4.

loop.description: Repeat a short track to the end; default true.

mix.description: Loudness of whole tracks (1 = as recorded).

lines.description: Over 1 is louder than the common level.

bg.description: Another angle of the scene's place for this shot only (a reverse angle, the scale up close): a library background, cut straight with no fade. The scene's decor stays on the scene's own picture.

audio.description: Optional. Path relative to the episode folder. When omitted the audio step writes ses/<shot_id>-<n>.wav. Sidecars <name>.words.json and <name>.rhubarb.json are optional.

delay.description: Extra seconds of silence before this line (on top of the usual lead or gap).

volume.description: Loudness of this line (1 = the common level, up to 2 = twice as loud).

duygu.description: How the line is said: shifts the speaker's rate, pitch and loudness (ses.mjs MOODS). Without it the speaker's own voice (flat).

altyazi.description: false: this line has no caption (default: shown).

dx.description: Stand this many world units right (negative: left) of the mark. The marks stay as snapping points; a walk starts from here.

back.description: How far back the character stands: 0 on the front ground line, 1 as far back as it goes (higher up and smaller, drawn behind those in front).

varyant.description: A costume variant of the character's drawing for this shot (character.json varyantlar): parts marked for it show or hide, and its colours apply. Leave it out for the drawing as it is.

ifade.description: The face: notr, gulumse (smile), kizgin (angry), uzgun (sad), sasirmis (surprised) or korkmus (scared), for the whole shot, or a list of moments [{ifade, at}] in seconds from the shot start (neutral before the first). The brows hold it while the character speaks; the mouth follows the speech and shows the expression in its silences. Without ifade the face follows the duygu of the line being spoken (kizgin, uzgun, korkmus; heyecanli: sasirmis; neseli: gulumse).

from.description: Start the action this many seconds in (continue a movement across a cut: cut on action).

actions.description: Actions played after `action` in the same shot (walk, stop, bend to pick up...): each starts at `at` seconds into the shot, in time order. `action` plays from the start until the first of these.

walk.description: Walk dx world units from the mark (negative = left) at constant speed over time seconds (default: the whole shot). Pair with a walk-cycle action.

dx.description: Direction and length of the walk: positive walks to the right, negative to the left (someone coming in from the right walks with a negative dx). Set the cast.dx start so the walk ends where they should stop.

arrive.description: Walk in from dx before the mark and stop on it (instead of starting on the mark).

sfx.description: Library sound effects played in this shot, each tied to one thing: at (seconds from the start of the shot), a line (replik, optionally its word kelime), a moment of someone's action (oyuncu + an), or someone's walk (oyuncu + adim: a step sound on every step). ofset moves it (seconds, may be negative). An effect stops where its shot ends.

replik.description: The line of this shot (0 = first) the effect starts with.

kelime.description: With replik: the word of that line (0 = first) it starts with.

oyuncu.description: A cast member of this shot: with an, a moment of their actions; with adim, their walk.

an.description: With oyuncu: the start of the shot's action, or the moment the action takes, puts away or sets down its prop.

adim.description: With oyuncu: a step sound on every step of their walk (cast.walk).

kilit.description: The person decided how this shot is made (e.g. one unbroken close shot). The film rules give way: their warnings for this shot are listed as the person's decision (kisi_kararlari), not as warnings. Set only on the person's word.

zaman_atlama.description: This shot comes after a jump in time within its scene (a montage: 'all morning he walked'). People and props may be elsewhere than at the end of the shot before; the continuity checks do not compare across this cut.

props.description: Library props in this shot. A prop rests on the ground at its mark (+dx world units) until its holder's action reaches its grab time; from then on it is in the holder's hand. A holder whose action has no grab holds it from the start of the shot.

to.description: Handed over: at the holder's release (an action with release) the prop goes into this cast member's hand. One prop, never two copies in two hands.

gizli.description: Taken out of a bag or a pocket: the prop lies nowhere before its holder's grab (no copy on the ground, no reach to check).

sonra.description: Where the prop lies once the holder sets it down (an action with put_down): on a scale, a table, the floor. Without it, at the holder's feet.

depth.description: Place the prop inside the background (background coordinates) instead of at a mark, so a dolly move brings it closer. Use with perspective backgrounds (data-vp).

voice.description: How a character speaks (Edge TTS): a ready voice and small changes to it.

hazir.description: A ready voice from the library (library/sesler/sesler.json: kadin, kadin-2, erkek, erkek-kalin, yasli, cocuk). Without it the library's first voice.

perde.description: Pitch shift in Hz on top of the ready voice (-: deeper, +: higher).

hiz.description: Speaking rate change in % on top of the ready voice and the profile tempo.
